basic_details.job_title: RITES AM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 27 Assistant Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: RITES Limited is hiring for 27 AM-Mechanical contract posts in Tamil Nadu, and online applications close on 20 November 2026. Mechanical Diploma or B.Tech holders with QA/QC/Testing experience can apply, up to a maximum age of 40. Two of the three posts also need ASNT / ISNT Level-II certification. The written test is on 29 November 2026, and monthly gross pay is Rs. 38,085.

application_fee.details: Fees are paid online through the application portal. A fee sent by any other mode will not be accepted, and the application will be summarily rejected. For posts not reserved for SC / ST / PwD candidates, candidates from those categories must also pay the full fee at this stage. SC/ST/PwBD candidates must submit their certificate through the portal at the time of payment to be considered for a refund. Make sure the invoice is generated after payment. If you cannot download it, email [email protected] immediately with your registration details. Fee payment helpdesk: 011 – 33557000, Extension Code 13221, or [email protected].

how_to_apply: Open the Career Section of the RITES website and use the online registration format.
Note the Registration No. generated at the top of the online form, and quote it in all further communication with RITES.
Fill in your details under "Fill/ Modify Application Form". Enter your Identity Proof details correctly and keep that proof available, because the original may be required at later stages.
Upload all documents under the "Upload Document" section. Scanned copies must be clear and visible.
Pay the fee under the "Make Payment" section. An application without successful fee payment is treated as incomplete and is summarily rejected.
Download the final application form after payment, then print, sign and retain a copy.
Do not send hard copies of documents to RITES by post or courier.
You can submit only one application for one vacancy, and it cannot be altered once submitted. A valid e-mail ID is essential.

For current employment: experience certificate or joining letter, along with last month's salary slips or Form 16, and other proof of continuity in the job
SC/ST candidates use the format in Annexure I, and OBC-NCL candidates use the format in Annexure II. Certificates must be valid on the last date of application.
OBC-NCL candidates must also furnish the Annexure III declaration during document verification. Their certificate must not be older than one year on the last date of application.
EWS candidates must hold an Income and Asset Certificate in the Govt. of India format, valid for FY 2026-27 as on the last date of application.
OBC NCL and EWS candidates get a further chance to submit a valid certificate on the date of joining. If they still cannot, they will be treated as UR Category candidates.

Send queries only to [email protected], in advance of the last date. Include the VC No., Registration/Roll No., your full name in block letters, and the valid email address given in the application. Messages without these details will not be attended to. Queries about information already in the advertisement will also not be attended to.

content_sections.heading: RITES AM-Mechanical Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 40 years. Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are counted as on the last date of application, 20 November 2026. UR/EWS candidates, and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts, need a first class degree or minimum 60% marks in the Minimum Qualification. Reserved category candidates need at least 50% marks in the Minimum Qualification for reserved posts. The Diploma or Degree must come from an Institution recognised by BTE/AICTE respectively, or from a University or Institution covered by the notice's other listed categories. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examination, treated as equivalent to a Degree by the Govt. of India and recognised by AICTE, is also accepted. Where a specialisation is required, the candidate must submit a certificate from the University or Institution clearly stating it. The date of acquiring the qualification is the earliest of four dates: the last day of the month of the final examination, the result declaration, the final marksheet issue, or the degree issue. Where the exact date of the written examination is stated, that date is used. No relaxation applies on this point. Diploma Holders: minimum 08 years of post-qualification experience in QA/QC/Testing (destructive/Non-destructive). Degree Holders: minimum 02 years of post-qualification experience in QA/QC/Testing (destructive/Non-destructive). This requirement is the same for all three posts. Experience is preferred in steel plants and rolling, forging or casting industries. SC/ST Category: 5 years OBC-NCL Category: 3 years Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years, in addition to the relaxation permissible for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates Required certificates must be produced. The PwBD relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved, provided the post is identified as suitable. Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability get PWD benefits. Reservation, relaxation and concessions for EWS, SC, ST, OBC (NCL), PWD, Ex-SM and J&K Domicile candidates apply against reserved posts, where applicable, as per extant Govt. orders. Persons with disabilities in the identified category can apply even if no vacancy is specifically reserved for them, and they will be considered by the general standard of merit. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post before applying.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on contract basis, initially for one year. It can be extended until completion of the assignment, subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance. Services can be terminated without notice or pay in lieu for unsatisfactory performance, inappropriate conduct, misbehaviour or wrongdoing, or if the client discontinues services. Selected candidates are liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements. Offers will be issued only on project or company requirement and on meeting the criteria for deployment in projects. Departmental candidates of RITES and candidates working in Government Departments/ PSU can join only after being properly relieved by their parent organisation. Management may cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify or alter the selection process at any stage without further notice. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute is Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for both AM-Mechanical-II and AM-Mechanical-III?
faq.answer: You can apply for any number of vacancies separately. However, the written test for CL/10/26 and CL/11/26 is held on the same date and at the same time, so check your eligibility and apply accordingly.

faq.question: Q2. Is there negative marking in the RITES written test?
faq.answer: No. No marks are deducted for an incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q3. How many candidates are called for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are called in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q4. Does training or internship count as experience?
faq.answer: No. Training (except on the job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship and PhD research experience are not counted.

faq.question: Q5. Is an offer letter accepted as proof of experience?
faq.answer: No. You must submit a joining and relieving order or an experience certificate to claim that experience.

faq.question: Q6. Will SC, ST and PwD candidates get the fee back?
faq.answer: Their fee is refunded after they take part in the further selection process of written exam or interview, as applicable, and their category certificate is scrutinised. The refund goes to the source account or card used for payment, after deducting GST and bank charges as applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What if my mark sheet shows only CGPA?
faq.answer: You must provide the conversion formula used by your university or institution. If it has no formula, submit an undertaking to that effect signed by its authorised representative. A minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale will then be considered as 60%.

faq.question: Q8. Does RITES pay travel allowance for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no fares, TA or DA shall be payable.

faq.question: Q9. Does being placed on the panel guarantee a job?
faq.answer: No. Empanelment against a vacancy does not guarantee selection or a right to the job, and deployment depends entirely on project or company requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where will changes to this recruitment be published?
faq.answer: Any corrigendum or addendum will be displayed only on www.rites.com. Other recruitment updates may be sent to your registered e-mail address or uploaded on the RITES website.
